verdict.rationale: Relay documents automatic syncing of detailed transaction data, receipts and categorized expenses into QuickBooks Online and Xero, which reduces manual journal entries. The evidence shows only a one-way push into accounting software, and no true ERP systems are named. Missing for 10: evidence of bidirectional sync (ERP changes flowing back to Relay), explicit real-time sync latency guarantees, support for ERP systems beyond QBO/Xero, independent or hands-on corroboration of sync reliability.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can rely on real-time bidirectional sync with my ERP instead of manual journal entries

citations.quote: Relay syncs ultra-detailed, easy-to-understand transaction data directly into QuickBooks Online and Xero.
Capture receipts, categorize expenses in real time, and sync everything to your accounting software automatically.
